# Agent Plugins for Codex and Claude Code

Ask Codex or Claude Code to review a diff, investigate a failure, or edit a draft without losing your voice. Each skill supplies a procedure for that job, including the evidence to gather and the checks to make before calling it done.

The collection contains 46 skills covering software development, documentation, project memory, writing, and product decisions. Install the plugin for your agent, then choose a skill from the catalogue below.

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills?sort=semver)](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/releases/latest) [![Build](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions/workflows/regenerate-skills.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions/workflows/regenerate-skills.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

## Quick start

### Codex

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills --ref master
codex plugin add agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
codex plugin list
```

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills@master
claude plugin install agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
```

If Claude Code is already running, use `/reload-plugins` after installation.

### Try it

```text
Use code-review to review my uncommitted changes and identify missing regression tests.
Use humanizer to edit this draft. Keep the facts and my voice.
```

## Choose a skill

| What you have | Start with | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A diff to review | [`code-review`](agent-plugins/skills/code-review/SKILL.md) | Confirmed defects, evidence, and missing test scenarios. |
| A failing test or runtime error | [`debugging-and-error-recovery`](agent-plugins/skills/debugging-and-error-recovery/SKILL.md) | A traced cause, a focused fix, and verification. |
| A feature that needs clearer scope | [`write-spec`](agent-plugins/skills/write-spec/SKILL.md) | Requirements and boundaries you can test. |
| A green check you want to trust | [`prove-checks`](agent-plugins/skills/prove-checks/SKILL.md) | Evidence that the check can detect the claimed failure. |
| A draft that needs a natural edit | [`humanizer`](agent-plugins/skills/humanizer/SKILL.md) | Clearer phrasing that keeps your meaning and voice. |
| A product idea to evaluate | [`business-viability-assessment`](agent-plugins/skills/business-viability-assessment/SKILL.md) | A viability assessment and a practical validation plan. |

Give the agent the relevant files, diff, requirements, or draft. Name the result you want and any constraints it needs to respect.

Review skills such as `code-review`, `plan-review`, and `review-spec` return findings. `fix-pr` handles existing GitHub review comments and applies valid fixes. Choose the skill for the work you want the agent to do.

## Updating

Refresh your marketplace, then update the installed plugin. The marketplace commands below follow `master`.

### Codex

```bash
codex plugin marketplace upgrade valentin-agent-plugins
codex plugin add agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace update valentin-agent-plugins
claude plugin update agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
```

Use `/reload-plugins` in an open Claude Code session. Restart Codex to load the updated plugin in an existing app session.

## How it works

The same canonical instructions produce both platform packages. Skills live in [`agent-plugins/skills/`](agent-plugins/skills/), with shared resources in [`agent-plugins/shared/`](agent-plugins/shared/). The generator builds complete copies under [`codex/skills/`](codex/skills/) and [`claude/skills/`](claude/skills/).

Codex reads [`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`](.codex-plugin/plugin.json), and Claude Code reads [`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`](.claude-plugin/plugin.json). Each package includes the instructions and resources its skills need.

## Contributing and development

Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and contribution guidance. Edit skills in `agent-plugins/skills/` and this README's catalogue and template in [`scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py`](scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py), then regenerate the output.

Run the repository checks after your changes:

```bash
python scripts/validate_skills.py
python scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py --clean
python scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py --check --clean --strict-links
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The [release workflows](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions) publish versioned archives for both platforms on the [releases page](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/releases).
